settings.heading: Compression, done by someone who fits it for a living

settings.text: Vital Socks started in an orthotics practice, where the difference between a tight sock and a graded one is part of the job. The idea was simple: make compression socks people want to wear, and get the grading right.
Compression grading overseen by an orthotist
Compression range stated on every product
Sized by your ankle and calf, not your shoe

settings.heading: An orthotist, not a guess
settings.text: Vital Socks was started by an orthotist who measures and fits medical compression garments for her patients. She knows what the wrong pressure does to a leg, so she oversees the compression grading on every Vital design.

settings.heading: Rest days count too
settings.text: Slow Sundays, long drives, and the months when your legs are doing more work than usual.

settings.heading: Quiet, and quick
settings.text: The plain black pair: under trousers at work, over the calves on a dawn run.
